what: This line uses autoloading to automatically load the SuckerPunch adapter class when it’s needed within the ActiveJob library.
why: The code was added to resolve a bug where some backends didn't properly require the adapter initially. It also included a temporary fix to automatically load the TestAdapter, avoiding the need for explicit requiring [1][2].
next: Before making any changes, verify that the autoloading of the SuckerPunch adapter is still necessary for the intended functionality of ActiveJob.
